name: Big Cube Bonanza 2018
information:
Online Registration ends on 27th April and On the spot registration is available on 5th May from 9:00 to 9:15. Visit [registration and payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BigCubeBonanza2018#5281-registration-and-payments) for details.
The main event for the competition is 5x5. 5x5 Winner will be declared the winner of Big Cube Bonanza 2018.
